description: Defines the LocationModel class used in the Admin API module of OrangeHRM. The class serializes Location entity data for API responses, including properties like id, name, country details, address, and contact info.

classes.name: LocationModel
classes.description: API model class for serializing Location entity data, implementing Normalizable, with properties like id, name, country, address, contact info, and number of employees.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LocationModel with a Location entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
